interpretationSources.authority: Same-product contributor analysis and actual play observations, not an official FAQ.
supports: The trigger is true whole-turn end, later than the Ending phase.
Same-faction includes the owner, independently of the actual turn owner's faction.
Whole Draw1 qualifies; ordinary whole Draw2/3 does not. Iron Chain recast's Draw1 qualifies.
The entire discard invocation must discard exactly one Hand card; either its initiator or actual executor can provide the faction match. The Hand loser alone is insufficient.
Only a genuine zero-entity Slash Use qualifies, with normal target distance. A printed or material-converted Slash does not.
Choose an item not already performed by the same-faction group; with all four present, there is no remaining option.

interpretationSources.authority: Same-product contributor practical analysis, not an official FAQ.
supports: Goude's trigger follows Ending-phase effects such as Biyue and Changji.

implementationInferences: For each actual AfterTurnEnded binding, freeze the history cutoff, the owner's then-current effective faction, all seats currently sharing that faction, and the resulting four-bit executed mask at the binding's actual Begin. The official text and server-client mask do not specify historical faction sampling. Earlier Goude resolutions in this same window may therefore change eligibility for a later binding; no paid child recomputes its own frozen mask.

The text does not require a historical actor or the completed actual turn owner to remain alive. Whole-turn facts from dead actors are retained, and the living owner's current same-faction seat set includes such seats.

Draw qualification uses one genuine native whole invocation with actual count exactly one. Requested Draw2 with actual one because of card shortage follows that actual-count contract; no dedicated product FAQ was found for this shortage edge.

Discard qualification requires whole primary actual count one and Hand count one. Multi-card HE payments containing only one Hand card do not qualify. Native GeneralWeapon OutsideGame normalization counts as a primary equipment discard; Wood Ox spill, use/response costs, recast and death cleanup are excluded from logical discard invocations.

Zero-entity Slash history follows a real CardUseDeclared Use and the exact same-use native actor-replacement chain. Conversion activation costs alone do not establish material count. True response uses are determined by native Use; pure played Slash responses do not qualify.

Changing faction offers the current ordinary OL client domain Wei, Shu, Wu, Qun and Jin except the current effective faction. Initial setup SelectFaction is not a turn action. A later real Huashen declaration or invalidation replaces older effective-faction choices through the shared native faction mechanism; this interaction is an engine integration inference rather than a MengDa-specific FAQ.

The optional chosen action is fully native: Draw1, one actual opaque Hand discard including self, one normal-range zero-entity Slash Use, or one actual effective-faction mutation. Original frames, materials, history masks, payment and typed child returns are retained across source loss, death and cold replay.
